items.headline: 加薩警局遭空襲致死
items.context: 以色列對加薩北部一處警察哨所發動攻擊，造成多人死亡；不同單位公布的死亡人數不太一致，一說8人、一說7人。加薩內政部稱這是一場「令人髮指的屠殺」，罹難者包括警局主管；以色列軍方則表示，鎖定的是「恐怖分子」。

items.headline: 曼谷酒吧大火增至30死
items.context: 曼谷一間音樂酒吧發生的大火，死亡人數已經上修到30人。當地政府統計，超過70人受傷，其中24人傷勢仍然危急。曼谷市長也承諾，會加嚴消防安全的相關規定。

items.headline: 墨西哥告美移民拘留致死
items.context: 墨西哥政府正式對美國提出刑事告訴，指控多名墨西哥公民在美國移民暨海關執法局（ICE）的拘留或行動中死亡。墨西哥方面點名共有17名國民身亡，同時也發出勒令停止的存證信函。

items.headline: 美撤荷姆茲收費仍封鎖
items.context: 美國總統川普撤回了才提出不到一天的荷姆茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）貨輪收費構想，但美軍對伊朗港口的海上封鎖照樣持續。伊朗方面則揚言，要自行掌控這條戰略航道。
items.thread_text:
美國總統川普（Donald Trump）撤回了才提出不到一天的荷姆茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）貨輪收費構想——原本打算對過往貨輪徵收20%的費用。不過收費喊卡歸喊卡，美軍對伊朗港口的海上封鎖行動照樣繼續。伊朗這邊則放話，要自己掌控這條戰略航道的進出。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Oobah Butler pulls some fun stunts in this takedown of the housing crisis, such as hypnotising estate agents and renting prison cells. But his trip to a graveyard is brutally symbolic Why can no one of my generation find an affordable place to live? Andy Burnham, who makes a surprise cameo on the new Channel 4 satire How to Trick Your Way Onto the Property Ladder, has two words: “Margaret Thatcher.” The housing crisis is a policy issue, but the presenter Oobah Butler wants to trial wackier workarounds for millennials keen to game a rigged system. Butler’s tongue-in-cheek documentary explores some elaborate parodic ideas, using himself and two young, hopeful first-time buyers, Mohammed and Insaf, as guinea pigs. Have they tried the bank of Mum and Dad? Let’s try to hypnotise an estate agent into selling us a property for a fiver. Perhaps it’s just about cutting out Netflix and coffees? Or could he swindle some property off the king? Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A Mexican student’s post-exams night out becomes a heady voyage of self-discovery in this slight but joyful coming-of-age drama This queer coming-of-age drama from Mexico feels a little familiar, with its story of 18-year-old Eduardo, a small-town boy finding himself in the big city. And yet nothing about it feels forced or fake – it is upfront about pleasure and desire, Eduardo’s teenage horniness and his intense need to be in the gay world. There are terrific performances from its young cast too. Alejandro Quintana plays Eduardo, a studious kid who arrives in Mexico’s second largest city, Guadalajara, in a sensible button-up shirt to sit a university entrance exam. His phone pings constantly with messages and calls from his mum, whose harsh tone suggests a tension, possibly around his sexuality. After the exam Eduardo meets student Mario, a Caravaggio-esque beauty who invites him back to his house. But when they arrive – surprise! – Mario’s family have thrown him a birthday party. Which only briefly interrupts the hookup, since Mario is totally accepted at home. Continue reading...

items.headline: 回顧山姆尼爾五十年演藝路
items.context: 紐西蘭演員山姆·尼爾（Sam Neill）辭世，享壽78歲。他的演藝生涯橫跨五十年，演出超過150部電影與電視作品，從奧斯卡得獎片到《侏羅紀公園》這樣的商業鉅片都有他的身影。
items.thread_text:
紐西蘭演員山姆·尼爾（Sam Neill）辭世，享壽78歲。他的演藝生涯橫跨五十年，演出超過150部電影與電視作品——從拿下奧斯卡的作品，到《侏羅紀公園》（Jurassic Park）這樣的商業鉅片都有他的身影。尼爾在螢幕上遊走於浪漫男主角和個性反派之間，兩種角色都能演得有說服力，最讓大眾記得的還是他在《侏羅紀公園》裡飾演的古生物學家。

items.headline: 6月通膨降至3.5%
items.context: 美國6月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率降到3.5%，比5月的三年新高4.2%明顯趨緩，月增率也下滑0.8%，是2020年4月以來最大的單月降幅。不過隨著美伊衝突再度升溫，油價又開始往上衝，現在每加侖汽油價格比去年同期貴了70美分。
